rca of the issue: Prerendered route HTMLs (e.g. /cyber-risk-scorecard/, /resources/) reference /static/js/main.e6cc7a7c.js from yarn build output, but preview environment serves the webpack-dev-server (which exposes /static/js/bundle.js instead). Requests to main.e6cc7a7c.js fall through the SPA index fallback and return text/html, causing 'Unexpected token <' JS parse errors and no React hydration on prerendered pages. Reproduction: curl -sI https://veracity-ai-managed.preview.emergentagent.com/static/js/main.e6cc7a7c.js -> 200 text/html (should be application/javascript). Mitigation: ensure preview env serves /app/frontend/build/static/* directly for prerendered routes, or point prerender to reference /static/js/bundle.js when running behind dev server. Out of scope for E1's current metadata-only change.
